description: This file contains a class `VertexAIImagenImageEditConfig` which configures and interacts with the Vertex AI Imagen image editing API. It includes methods for parameter mapping, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing specific to the Vertex AI Imagen model, used within a larger machine learning project.
